subject: Mutual Action Playbook: KiteMetrics onboarding & cutover orchestration
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: natalie@kitemetrics.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Playbook: KiteMetrics onboarding & cutover orchestration

Natalie —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. Per our conversation I put together an initial mutual action playbook (MAP) and the high-level cutover orchestration we discussed. The attached spreadsheet is an editable tracker with milestone owners, acceptance criteria, and a proposed two-week sprint cadence to go from sandbox -> pilot -> production.

Key asks for today:
- Please confirm the proposed kickoff window (week of 6/8) or suggest availability.
- Confirm who will be the primary security/contact for SOC2 evidence and network details.
- Flag any hard compliance constraints (data residency, retention windows, audit access) that would change the timeline.

High-level milestones (see attachment for full lanes):
1) Kickoff & access provisioning — week of 6/8 — owner: Jonas Weber (AE) / KiteMetrics DevOps to grant sandbox access
2) Data ingest & schema validation — target complete by 6/18 — owner: KiteMetrics DevOps / Redwood integration engineer (Marissa)
3) Performance baseline & cost tuning — target complete by 6/25 — owner: Ben Carter (SRE)
4) Pilot acceptance & QoS checks — target complete by 7/2 — owner: KiteMetrics (Natalie) / Redwood CSM (Marissa)
5) Production cutover & rollback window — target week of 7/6 — owner: KiteMetrics ops / Redwood ops (Ben)

Attachments: KiteMetrics_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (tracker), reference SOW will follow as PDF.

If this looks reasonable I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff and include Marissa for the technical run-of-show and Ben for cutover/RTO planning.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0191

--
From: Natalie Park <natalie@kitemetrics.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, devops@kitemetrics.com
Date: 2026-06-02T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Playbook: KiteMetrics onboarding & cutover orchestration

Jonas —

Thanks for the plan and clear milestones. A few quick notes from the KiteMetrics side:
- Kickoff: week of 6/8 works best for us; can do Tue/Wed mornings PT.
- Security: please include our security lead (sec@kitemetrics.com) on the SOC2 evidence thread — we’ll need your SOC2 type II and encryption-in-transit details.
- Data residency: production data must remain in us-west-2; sandbox can be in a different region if needed.
- Retention: logs retained 1 year, customer PII retained 90 days unless otherwise approved.

We reviewed the attachment briefly and will add a column for our internal acceptance criteria. Also, can you confirm whether Redwood supports an on-prem sidecar for the ingestion agent (we may want to run the agent in our VPC for the pilot)?

Natalie Park
Head of MLOps | KiteMetrics
natalie@kitemetrics.com

Subject: RE: Mutual Action Playbook: KiteMetrics onboarding & cutover orchestration

Hi Natalie, Jonas —

Appreciate the quick responses. I pulled the proposed MAP into the onboarding tracker and sketched a pragmatic implementation timeline that accounts for your constraints (region & retention). Below is a condensed runbook we plan to execute — I’ll update the shared Drive tracker with these dates and owner assignments (link in metadata).

Condensed Implementation Runbook (owner / target date / acceptance criteria):
- Access & Security Kickoff: Marissa Cole / 2026-06-09 / open items: SOC2 report, KMS key exchange plan, IP allowlist
- Sandbox provisioning & agent deploy (POC): Marissa Cole / 2026-06-11 / agent runs, sample ingest < 1k rows/min, basic schema pass
- Schema & transform verification: KiteMetrics DevOps / 2026-06-15 / schema conformance tests pass 95%
- Load & performance test (baseline): Ben Carter / 2026-06-22 / p95 latency < 500ms at 200 rps, CPU/GPU utilization documented
- Pilot acceptance (business QA): Natalie Park / 2026-06-30 / functional parity checklist signed, regression tests green
- Production cutover (canary first): Ben Carter / 2026-07-07 / canary success 72h, rollback plan validated

Security/Network notes:
- We can provide a VPC-private deployment for production in us-west-2. For the agent sidecar, Redwood supports an inbound-only connector that does not require inbound traffic to your network; we’ll document port/IP requirements.
- Action: Mina Haddad (security) will share the SOC2 snapshot and a short whitepaper on our encryption and key management process by 6/05.

Next steps:
1) Confirm Tue/Wed morning of 6/9 for the kickoff (Jonas to schedule).
2) KiteMetrics to add acceptance criteria column to tracker.
3) Redwood to upload SOC2 snapshot and SOW PDF (Jonas).

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

All —

Thanks Marissa & Natalie. I've scheduled the kickoff for Tuesday, 2026-06-09 at 10:00 AM PT and sent a calendar invite to the list. Quick logistics and links:
- Kickoff agenda (30 min): introductions, success criteria, access checklist, immediate blockers, next 2-week sprint goals.
- Links: HubSpot deal RDW-2026-0457, Drive tracker (see metadata).
- DocuSign: I initiated the SOW for signatures (KiteMetrics_SOW_v1.pdf attached) — please review prior to kickoff so we can align on commitments.

Open items I will own before kickoff: SOC2 snapshot upload (by 6/5), attach SOW to HubSpot, and confirm sandbox provisioning ETA with infra (Ben).
